mentions.name: min.
mentions.description: This app works like Airtable on top of an email client: users can add any column they want and the app automatically extracts structured data from emails, so teams can sort and group messages. The first use case is shared hello@ email addresses for founders.
mentions.audience: Founders managing shared hello@ email addresses
mentions.source_excerpt: Built min., it's like Airtable on top of an email client. Add any column you want, extract structured data from emails automatically, so you can sort, group, emails for your team.
